channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Zuckerberg says AI does not need industry-wide slowdown as market forces and competition will drive safety
item.description: Zuckerberg aligned with Nvidia's Jensen Huang, who has said AI companies should run as fast as they can.

item.title: Minneapolis considers requiring drivers in Waymos amid autonomous vehicle concerns
item.description: A proposed ordinance would require human safety monitors to be paid at least minimum wage to sit in self-driving cars.

item.title: AI agents go rogue as CIOs race to add guardrails
item.description: As AI agents take on more work and present new risks, Cisco, Intuit, Workday, and ServiceNow are creating oversight layers to monitor and govern them.

item.title: Fed unanimously raises interest rates for first time since 2023
item.description: Inflation has remained above 2% for five years, and the Fed decided that was long enough.
